workbook: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
scope: Official outlet-specific mall directories for Tiong Bahru Plaza and Causeway Point; exact existing SFA records with blank contact/site/hours only. No delivery platforms, paid API calls, Mapbox Search Box results, images, or nonofficial sources.
method: Current official F&B tenant feed records were joined to unique SFA rows by normalized exact tenant name, exact mall, exact postcode, and overlapping unit token. Proposed only blank fields. Direct official tenant detail pages had to return HTTP 200 and contain exact tenant name and unit. No stale values overwritten. Mall feed phone values explicitly marked unavailable were withheld.
